name: vclo-by-rohas
description: vCLO is a free, open-source AI legal team with one virtual Chief Legal Officer, nine specialist virtual lawyers, 168 specialist legal skills, coordinated workflows and company-registry access.

interface.longDescription: vCLO gives lawyers and businesses one virtual Chief Legal Officer, nine specialist virtual lawyers and 168 specialist legal skills. It handles focused legal tasks and coordinates complex matters such as M&A due diligence, contract negotiation, litigation and dispute-resolution preparation, compliance reviews, data-breach response and internal investigations. It can use authorised documents and connected services and includes access to official company-registry sources.
defaultPrompt: Run buyer-side legal due diligence on this acquisition and consolidate the key risks.
Review this MSA for the customer, propose redlines, and prepare negotiation positions.
Prepare our litigation case strategy from these pleadings, evidence, and deadlines.
